title: OffersIndex
description: Frozen data contract (issue #120, tasks.md Task 2.1) for the GENERATED offers.json / offers.jsonl artifacts produced by app/scripts/load-offers.mjs. This governs the build OUTPUT only — schemas/offer.schema.json still governs the YAML source and does not change. The pipeline validates its own output against this schema and fails the build on mismatch.

generated_at.description: Build timestamp, UTC, second precision with a trailing Z.

count.description: Total number of entries in offers (active + expired).

active_count.description: Entries whose status is active at build time.

expired_count.description: Entries whose status is expired at build time.

offers.description: All validated offers, newest-verified first (ties by slug ascending). Expired entries are retained and flagged, never dropped.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: One offer entry in the generated index. Mirrors the YAML source fields plus the slug and the build-time-computed status.

slug.description: File name of the source offers/<slug>.yaml without extension.

title.description: Human-readable offer name shown on cards.

provider.description: Company or product offering the credit.

amount.description: Free value in human terms, e.g. '$300 in credits'.

expiry_date.description: Date the offer stops being claimable, YYYY-MM-DD. Null means ongoing.

source_url.description: Official provider page describing the offer.

verified_date.description: Date the curator last verified the offer is live, YYYY-MM-DD.

review_status.description: Curator testing state, separate from evidence verification and build-time expiry.

status.description: Build-time expiry verdict (ADR 0001): computed against the BUILD clock, never a client clock.
